name: Slab Breaker
hook: Crack the graded slab before the grading purists epoxy it forever
tagline: A rogue preservationist taps a jewel hammer against an ultra-rare graded plastic cartridge case to dump the lost ROM for humanity. Cashing out pops the cartridge free into a card reader while the crowd cheers. Crashing smashes the brittle acrylic and crushes the vintage memory chip into fine dust.
